comparisons.explanation: C17 compared with C16; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: The actual linear transform has 19 weight tensors and no biases or SiLU, despite inherited activation=silu metadata. Common worst pressure error improves versus C16, while worst equation error changes little. Preserve executed structure separately from inherited labels.

comparisons.explanation: C18 compared with C20; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Four learned corrections improve the common equation error relative to the matched 5,000-update single-correction control C20. They cost more work within one pressure request; they are not four simulation steps. Prepared-field strategy also differs, so do not attribute all differences to recurrence alone.

comparisons.explanation: C19 compared with C17; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: The physical correction/gradient objective changes the meaning of logged training and validation loss. Its common pressure/equation errors trade off against C17 rather than establishing an overall gain. Pressure-equation diagnostics do not establish velocity/tracer drift.

comparisons.explanation: C20 compared with C18; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: This is the short-budget control for C18, not merely a renamed C17 checkpoint. Its first 5,000 physical sample selections match the longer fit, but its learning-rate changes occur at different updates.

comparisons.explanation: C24 compared with C21; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Single-correction deployment reduces internal work but loses common accuracy relative to C21. Every call still returns one pressure proposal; this result says nothing about multi-frame simulation generation.

comparisons.explanation: C25 compared with C23; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: The single-correction and lower-learning-rate changes do not retain C23 accuracy. More than one factor changes, so this is not an isolated causal test of learning rate or correction count.

comparisons.explanation: C27 compared with C26; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Two corrections improve both common worst errors over C26 with matching initialization, physical samples and manufactured draws. These corrections consume work inside a pressure call and produce no additional simulation frames.

comparisons.explanation: C28 compared with C27; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Broader physical fitting and train-cohort amplitude calibration improve both common errors over C27. Both factors change, so the effect cannot be assigned to scene count alone. The 16 physical trajectories remain small grids; the larger shapes are manufactured operator fields.

comparisons.explanation: C29 compared with C28; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Repeat the C28 two-correction policy with different model-initialization and physical-frame sampling seeds.

comparisons.explanation: C30 compared with C28; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Add a third initialization/sampling repeat of the C28 two-correction policy.

comparisons.explanation: C31 compared with C28; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: The single-correction cohort control is faster work in principle but materially less accurate than C28 on both common worst metrics. Use measured complete GPU latency for the actual speed tradeoff.

comparisons.explanation: C32 compared with C28; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Measure a four-correction control on the same 16-trajectory cohort and five-grid manufactured bank as C28.

comparisons.explanation: C33 compared with C28; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: The rectangular bank improves common worst equation error over C28 but worsens common worst pressure error. Five-grid exposures fall from 1,000 to 625 each when eight grids share the same 5,000 proposals; this is not an equal-exposure pure geometry comparison.

comparisons.explanation: C34 compared with C33; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: The second rectangular-bank seed pair improves both common worst errors relative to C33. Its range overlaps the five-grid repeat results, so a single best seed does not prove the bank universally superior.

comparisons.explanation: C36 compared with C33; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: The single-correction rectangular-bank control remains much less accurate than C33 on both common worst metrics. It improves over the corresponding five-grid single-correction control, while changing the allocation of manufactured exposures.

comparisons.explanation: C107 compared with C106; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Provide the matched half-width control without the teacher-correction loss, so the distillation intervention can be assessed against the same initial weights, data, update budget and source implementation. C107 is a sibling experiment of C106; it was not trained by continuing the completed C106 checkpoint.

comparisons.explanation: C38 compared with C33; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Both common worst errors improve over C33, but training budget and learning-rate schedule both change. More optimizer work does not imply more inference corrections or extra physical trajectories.

comparisons.explanation: C39 compared with C33; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Adding manufactured shapes does not improve these common worst errors over C33. Eleven grids redistribute 5,000 proposals into 454/455 exposures each instead of 625; this is not an equal-exposure pure shape comparison. Grid capacity 16 is a validation bound, not 16 executed grids or new CFD scenes.

comparisons.explanation: C40 compared with C33; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Intermediate contraction improves both common worst metrics over C33 at the same physical/manufactured sample budget and two-correction deployment. The larger logged training loss includes an extra term; final validation remains canonical. This does not establish complete-step or rollout improvement.

comparisons.explanation: C41 compared with C40; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Relative to C40, the extra primary stream lowers worst pressure error but raises worst equation error. More feedback work has a metric-dependent effect; the changed weighted training objective cannot be compared as the same scalar loss.

comparisons.explanation: C42 compared with C41; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: C42 improves both common worst pressure and equation errors over C41 at equal optimizer and proposal counts. Compared with C40, pressure improves but equation error remains worse. Geometry, stream size and per-grid exposure change together; this is diagnostic evidence for targeted feedback, not held-out generalization or extra physical-scene coverage.

comparisons.explanation: C43 compared with C44; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: C43 improves both common worst metrics over C42. Against the matched late-direction C44, early feedback gives lower worst pressure error but higher worst equation error. Early and late describe residual stages of a fixed eight-correction source, not physical simulation time or extra generated frames.

comparisons.explanation: C45 compared with C44; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: C45 is the zero-first-pressure-weight control on the expanded 192-case direction bank. It differs from C44 in 48 additional manufactured long-axis directions as well as regenerated bank identity; do not attribute that comparison solely to an objective coefficient.

comparisons.explanation: C46 compared with C45; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Relative to C45, a weight1.0 first-correction objective lowers worst equation error but raises worst pressure error. A lower residual tail does not guarantee a lower pressure tail, and this training term does not add inference passes.

comparisons.explanation: C47 compared with C45; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: A weight0.1 first-correction objective improves both common worst errors over C45 and C46. This favors a gentler training weight on the retained diagnostic population; independent seeds, held-out domains and rollouts remain unqualified.

comparisons.explanation: C48 compared with C47; retrospective source-review context, not a Trial ancestry assertion or new metric qualification.
comparisons.excerpt: Weight0.25 improves worst equation error over C45 but slightly raises worst pressure error. C47 at0.1 has lower values of both common worst errors. More first-correction supervision is not monotonically better.
